### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **4** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/types`, touching **31** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/api.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`, `packages/spec/declaration-map/api.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**31** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8fc50b7647d30db2a0837877cf251c1163a3239e`.

⛔ **11** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/api.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`, `packages/spec/declaration-map/api.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **143** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8fc50b7647d30db2a0837877cf251c1163a3239e` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `4f51f8374f71df82b70ea92fd6c83d733e6ec14a` — the merge of head `e2a28fadf1c02a48c965f0303776872e1a323b79` into base `8fc50b7647d30db2a0837877cf251c1163a3239e`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 4f51f8374f71df82b70ea92fd6c83d733e6ec14a && git checkout 4f51f8374f71df82b70ea92fd6c83d733e6ec14a
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 8fc50b7647d30db2a0837877cf251c1163a3239e e2a28fadf1c02a48c965f0303776872e1a323b79 && git checkout -B drift-repro 8fc50b7647d30db2a0837877cf251c1163a3239e && git merge --no-ff e2a28fadf1c02a48c965f0303776872e1a323b79

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8fc50b7647d30db2a0837877cf251c1163a3239e
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 8fc50b7647d30db2a0837877cf251c1163a3239e` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e2a28fadf1c02a48c965f0303776872e1a323b79`
Local-runs: none

PR #22126 (card #22114), branch `claude/issue-22114-meta-read-version-token`, draft, head repo = base repo, base `main` at `8fc50b7647d30db2a0837877cf251c1163a3239e`, 12 commits, 20 files, +899 / -43 (942 changed lines). Inputs read: the card body and all 7 comments (triage, claim, three dev reports, the round-1 patch order, the ACCEPT), the PR body, its file list, its one comment (docs drift, advisory), the net diff `main...head`, and the head's check-runs. Source at the head was read through the contents API only: `protocol.ts`, `rest-server.ts`, `metadata-redaction.ts`. Nothing was built, run or re-run.

**Check-runs on the head** (REST check-runs API, both reads): first read at 2026-10-08T02:54:41Z — 39 runs, 33 `success`, 5 `skipped`, 1 `in_progress` (`Check Changeset`, the re-run the `labeled` event started); second read at 2026-10-08T03:01:10Z — 39 runs, **34 `success`, 5 `skipped`, 0 failed, 0 in progress**. All seven required contexts `success`: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Build Core`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`. The five skipped are the opt-in tarball smoke, `Console Pin Gate` and the `labeled`-event duplicates of `Auto Label` / `Check PR Size`. No path in the file list is a governed surface; the review is owed on the `Clause-②: yes` limb and on the published-schema path limb (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`, `error-code-ledger.zod.ts`, non-test).

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`GetMetaItemResponseSchema.version` — `string | null`, optional (`protocol.zod.ts`).** A widened response accept set: a non-strict `z.object` used to strip the key, a parse now keeps it. **Right**, and the describe's three states match the runtime at the head: the draft branch always sets it (`protocol.ts` draft return); the active branch sets it unless `previewDrafts` (absent), and serves `null` when no stored row was found in scope or when the save's own address holds none. `readVersionToken` builds `getOverlayRepo(orgId ?? null)`, `ref = {singular type, name, org: orgId ?? 'env'}` and `storedHeadAt(repo, ref, state, packageId ?? null)`; the save door builds the identical four facts at its own `storedHeadAt` call (`orgId = request.organizationId ?? null`, `singularTypeForRepo`, `org: orgId ?? 'env'`, `packageId ?? null`). One head read, one producer (`receiptVersion`), so the read's token is the save's comparand byte for byte. The read side's `orgId` is `organizationIdForMetaRead(type, organizationId)` and the REST `PUT` folds its scope through `organizationIdForMetaWrite` before the protocol, so at the HTTP door both halves address one partition. The REST `GET` uncached arm passes `packageId = req.query.package || undefined` plus `state` / `previewDrafts` / `organizationId`; the cached-arm selector diverts `?state=draft`, `?preview=draft`, `?package=`, app / dashboard / book / doc types and `enableCache: false` deployments to that arm, so Studio's draft and package-scoped reads serve `version`, and the default cached plain read does not (its ETag stays the cache validator; pinned). Meets the card's Done-when ("at least `state=draft`, and the stored-row read a client edits from").

2. **New public exports `MetadataConflictErrorSchema`, `MetadataConflictError`, `MetadataConflictErrorParsed` from `@objectstack/spec/api`.** A public-surface widening. The eight generated artifacts moved in step: api-surface +3, export-origins +3, declaration-map +2, json-schema.manifest +1, authorable-surface +4 (`GetMetaItemResponse:version`, `MetadataConflictError:{code,currentVersion,error}`), strictness-ledger count 433 → 434, reference docs; `check:generated` sits inside the green required jobs. **Right.** The schema declares `currentVersion` REQUIRED (`string | null`) and `code` as the one literal. Judged against the producer: `metadataConflictRefusal` sets `currentVersion` whenever `servedContentHash(actualHead, digest)` is not `undefined`; `storedHashDigest()` always returns a digest (the provider's keyed digest or the ephemeral process key), and `servedContentHash` is `undefined` only for a non-string non-null head, which the repository does not produce — so every refusal the builder composes states it. All five `metadataConflictRefusal` call sites at the head are the four item doors (save, both the token-resolution and the repository-race site; publish; rollback; reset). The schema's scope note excludes the batch publish's `failed[]` rows and raw repository shapes, and the `@objectstack/types` arm keys on presence, keeping the passthrough body for a `METADATA_CONFLICT` that states none (the parity control). **Right.**

3. **`PUT /meta/:type/:name` request accept set (`metaSavePreconditionPin`, `rest-server.ts`).**
   - `If-None-Match: *` (whitespace tolerated) → `parentVersion: null`, the first-write pin `SaveMetaItemRequestSchema` already declared, now reachable over HTTP; refused `409 METADATA_CONFLICT` once a row of the target lifecycle exists. A widening. **Right**, pinned on draft and active.
   - `If-None-Match` with any value other than `*`, and `If-None-Match` beside `If-Match` → `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, nothing written. Before the head the door did not read the header, so these requests were answered `200` and written: **a narrowing of a published door's accept set**, and the dev's original `(widening)` grade for it was wrong; the round-1 regrade to narrowing is **right**. Refusing rather than dropping is right (a dropped precondition writes a caller unguarded who asked for a guard — route rule 5's reason); the pair refusal is right under RFC 9110 §13.2.2 (both are evaluated, the pair can never hold, and a `409` would loop the caller through a re-read). The `400` body is the nested ADR-0112 form this route's other `VALIDATION_ERROR` refusals use; `check:route-envelope` is green. The closed value set is declared the day the header is first read on this route.
   - `If-Match` alone (quotes stripped) and neither header (last-writer-wins): unchanged, with the control pinned. **Right.**

4. **`@objectstack/types` `structuredCodeAnswer` — the `METADATA_CONFLICT` arm.** Serializes `currentVersion` (presence-keyed; `null` relayed as the answer "no row") into the flat 409 body on both doors, keyed on the code AND a stated `currentVersion`; the door-parity test (token, `null`, control) and the sandbox-arm census row cover it. A published behaviour change of `@objectstack/types`, so its `minor` is right. `error-code-ledger.zod.ts` registers the stamp site under the `@objectstack/types` owner key — provenance only, the `ErrorCode` union unchanged — which is what turned `check:error-code-provenance` green on this head after the red on `54ae811d4`. **Right.**

5. **Describe-only corrections** on `SaveMetaItemResponseSchema.version`, `PublishMetaItemResponseSchema.version`, `PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema.published[].version` and `SaveMetaItemRequestSchema.parentVersion`: no type or accept-set change; the text now names the served `hmac-sha256:` token and the `METADATA_CONFLICT` wire code, and the regenerated reference docs carry the same words. **Right.**

6. **`packages/objectql/src/protocol-meta.test.ts`**: the count-of-2 pin became the exact read sequence (`app`, `apps`, then the save-address head; `version: null` because the served row sits under the other spelling). Test only; the third read is the one extra keyed `findOne` the PR declares as cost. **Right.**

7. **Unchanged, as the PR states**: `GET …/layers` serves no `version`; the `DELETE` door reads no `If-None-Match`; `packages/client` is untouched (the read type is the spec's, and the flat conflict body already reaches `err.details`); the runtime dispatcher's item read carries `version` because it rides the protocol envelope (parity suites green). No lenient alias or consumer fallback was added anywhere in the diff.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/22114-meta-read-version-token.md`: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/types` — all `minor`. Every published package the diff moves is named; the other touched trees (`packages/objectql` test only, `content/docs/references/**`, `docs/audits/**`) publish nothing. **Matches the diff.**
- The PR body and the changeset both carry the line reading `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`. A legal combination of the closed grammar: `yes` for the widened read member, new exports, request header and conflict field; `(narrowing)` for the two `PUT /meta` request shapes now refused `400`. **Right** — `yes` takes at least `minor` (held), and the arm is BREAKING, so the changeset owes the two launch-window carriers: the `**BREAKING**` paragraph names both refused shapes and the remedy (send `*` alone, or `If-Match` with the version read, never both), and exactly one ADR-0087 marker reads `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. The category is right: no authorable key, export, response field or stored shape moves, so there is nothing for `objectstack migrate meta` to rewrite, and which precondition a sender meant is client intent no conversion entry can derive. `check:adr-0087-registration` and `check:changeset-no-major` run inside the green `Lint & Repo Gates` / `Check Changeset`.
- Level `minor`, not `major`: the launch-window convention (`check-changeset-no-major.mjs`) ships a breaking change as `minor` and refuses a `major` outside pre-mode; `.changeset/pre.json` is absent on `main` at the PR's base `8fc50b764` (contents API 404, against 200 for `.changeset/config.json` at the same ref — read by this review, not taken from the report). **Right.**
- The card claim's arm-less `Clause-②: yes` is not the carrier; the PR body is, and it reads the arm.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions[0]` (H3, an ETag equal to the token?)** — seat ruled A (body member only): **answered, judged right.** The only branch that sets an ETag is the cached arm, whose validator folds locale, the ADR-0106 D3 visibility fingerprint and the served bytes; the token varies with none of those, and `getMetaItemCached`'s pinned contract forbids a version marker in its place. The card's Done-when takes "a body member, an `ETag`, or both".
- **`open_questions[1]` (grade of the two `400` refusals)** — seat ruled A plus the narrowing arm: **answered, judged right** (①-3, ②). Option B (ignore a non-`*` value) would write a caller unguarded and is rightly not taken.
- **Dev deviation: `packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts` outside the claimed surface** — seat accepted: **right**; the producer of the flat body is `structuredCodeAnswer`, which `error-response.ts` names as the home of a new code arm, and it carries its own `minor`.
- **Dev deviations: `error-code-ledger.zod.ts` (a provenance row, not the `details` declaration the claim anticipated) and `packages/objectql/src/protocol-meta.test.ts` (a consumer pin this read's extra `findOne` broke)** — seat recorded both: **right**, both are what the red on `54ae811d4` demanded and no production line moved for the second.
- **Round-0 "not merged with main"** — closed: `origin/main` was merged twice since (`0bb0202bc`, `68a14c74b`) through `os-regen-merge.sh`; the compare against the base is clean.
- **Out-of-scope finding 0 → #22128** (package-less draft path; this read's `version` inherits it, serving `null` while a draft exists on that path): filed, named in the PR body, the describe left true by #22128's fix at the shared head read. **Carried.**
- **Dispatcher / hono catch-all `PUT /meta` ignoring `If-Match`, `If-None-Match` and `?mode=draft` → #22141**; cloud hosts' routing NOT MEASURED from this session: filed by the seat, pre-existing, not this PR's. **Carried.**
- **`plugin-rest-api.zod.ts` `/publish` describe still says `metadata_conflict`** — rides #22128 per the seat. **Carried.**
- **`GET /meta/:type/:name?package=all` serves `version: null` for the package-less row the save would write** — noted by the dev, kept in the Acceptance notes by the seat. Confirmed at the head: the `GET` hands the literal `all` to the protocol as `packageId`, the `PUT` folds `all` to the env-local overlay. A client that reads and saves with `?package=all` gets a `null` it would pin with `If-None-Match: *` and is refused `409` when the package-less row exists; it recovers from the 409's `currentVersion`, and no write lands unguarded, so this is not a FAIL. **Escalated to the seat**: a reproducible wrong first answer at a public door is a Prime Directive #10 card, not an acceptance note — file it (or rule it a note on the record) before the PR's Acceptance notes are the only place it lives.
- **`dispatch-gates --commands` leaving the artifact-roster block outside the harvest** — documented tool behaviour per the dev; for the seat's dispatch brief, no action in this record.
- **Probe hygiene** (the one-off hono harness, deleted and never committed; the `--shallow-since` fetch): nothing reaches the diff. No model identifier appears in the PR title, body, changeset or diff.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-22114-meta-read-version-token`
Reviewed-by: `session_01RPo7FUd6bSnAfkWMAKi848`

**VERDICT: PASS**
